modules.title: Checked baggage

max_weight.value: For safety and operational reasons the maximum weight per piece is 32 kg (71 lbs); heavier baggage may be rejected.

prepaid_excess.value: Extra baggage can be bought online, in the app or through the reservation center up to 48 hours before departure; airport baggage rates apply on the day. Example given by Air Premia: departing from Korea to Northeast Asia, an extra piece up to 23 kg costs KRW 60,000 prepaid, and a 26 kg extra piece costs KRW 60,000 plus KRW 25,000 overweight = KRW 85,000.

limits.value: Excess baggage is limited to a maximum of 2 pieces per person. Economy Lite and Wide Premium fares cannot prepay overweight baggage, only additional pieces. Codeshare and partner-operated flights are not eligible.

modules.lede: Check your free baggage allowance on your booking before buying extra baggage.
